messages:
Nora (Design): quick thread — how should the alert preview show provenance when routing rules chain? current mock just flattens recipients, people ask 'which rule added this?' link: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/provenance-mock.png
Keisha (PM): users need to know which rule created each endpoint and whether suppression applies at the rule or global level. avoids surprises during maintenance.
Rohit (Frontend): proposal: compact rows with endpoint + small 'via <rule>' badge(s). when multiple rules map to same endpoint, merge by default and add a '+N rules' affordance that expands to rule-level breakdown. expansion lazy-loads.
Ellie (Accessibility): a11y requirements: the merged row must include rules in the aria-label, e.g. 'Slack #incident, via primary-route and escalation-route'. '+N rules' must be keyboard focusable with aria-expanded and when expanded announce the list via aria-live. suppressed rows should be prefixed '(Suppressed)'.
Sam (SRE): backend will return resolvedRecipients with rule metadata including suppressed_by (id + reason) and timestamps. sample payload we can return: ```["endpoint: slack:#ops (rules: primary-route (suppressed: maintenance-123), escalation-route)"]``` Also add an endpoint-level merged id so UI can unambiguously map rows. Ticket INF-5401 opened.
Nora (Design): microcopy: change header from 'Notify when threshold is met' to 'Alert when threshold is reached' across alert flows. suppression pill should read 'Suppressed — maintenance until Jul 12, 2024 18:00 UTC' rather than just 'Suppressed'. '+N' copy: '+2 contributing rules' (explicit).
Keisha (PM): decision list: 1) merge duplicate endpoints in compact preview, show 'via' badges 2) provide '+N contributing rules' control to expand rule-level view 3) expansion lazy-loads and shows suppression per-rule 4) prefixed '(Suppressed)' text for screenreaders + aria-live announcements 5) copy change to 'Alert when threshold is reached' 6) frontend to show spinner during lazy load; backend to include suppressed_by metadata. Owners: Nora (design), Rohit (frontend), Sam (backend), Ellie (a11y).
design-bot: figma updated https://figma.redwood.app/file/provenance/preview-v2 (published).
Rohit (Frontend): i'll add a dev story with example payload and keyboard walkthrough. will link INF-5401 once PR created.
Ellie (Accessibility): i'll add checklist: aria-label pattern, aria-expanded on toggles, aria-live region for expansions, focus management, tooltip keyboardability.
Nora (Design): thanks — i'll close when figma + INF-5401 + dev story links are posted. :white_check_mark:
